label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
**★★★★☆**

Used Kilbarrack Van Co for my move on Saturday 17th October, Phibsborough to Drumcondra. It was a 2 bed flat but mostly just my own stuff, and the new place is a 4th floor walkup with no lift, so not the easiest job. Putting down the good and the not so good because I read loads of these before picking a company and the honest ones were the most useful.

**Booking and price**

Booked through their website and paid a €50 deposit by Revolut, very straightforward. The quote was €340 for up to 4 hours with 2 lads and the van. Every other quote I got was €450 or more, so they were the best value I found by a distance. The whole job took about three and a half hours, which I thought was decent going with four flights of stairs at the far end.

**The lateness**

They were meant to arrive at 9 and got there at half 10. To be fair to them I got a text at 8:40 saying the job before had run over, so I wasn't left wondering. Still, I spent an hour and a half sat on boxes with a cold coffee. For me it wasn't the end of the world because I'd no rush on. **But if you're on a tight handover with a landlord or have to be out of your old place by a set time, I'd mention that when you book and ask for the first slot of the day.** That's probably the most useful thing I can tell anyone reading this.

Without me asking, Dessie knocked €40 off at the end because of the delay. That said a lot about how he runs things, and I appreciated it.

**On the day**

Once they arrived they were brilliant. My couch wouldn't go round the turn on the 3rd floor, and I was already picturing it stuck there forever. The young lad (Kev I think?) pulled an allen key out of his pocket, had the legs off in about two minutes and it went straight in. No drama, no huffing, just sorted it.

They also put my bed back together without being asked, which is the last thing you want to be doing yourself at the end of a moving day. They took away a flat pack shelf I didn't want too, which saved me a trip.

**The one thing that went wrong**

Almost everything got wrapped in blankets, but my brass floor lamp didn't, and the base got chipped. It was my nanny's lamp so I was a bit gutted. It's not a disaster and I know accidents happen on stairs, but it was the one thing not wrapped and the one thing that got damaged. So if you've anything delicate or sentimental, point it out to them at the start and ask for it to be wrapped. And lads, if you're reading this, wrap the lamps 😄

**Overall**

Giving 4 stars rather than 5 because of the lateness and the lamp. Apart from those two things they were great. Hard working, sound, good humoured and good value. I'd use them again and I'd recommend them, especially if you're on a budget and have a bit of flexibility on timing.

Tips if you're booking:
- Ask for the first job of the day if your timing is tight
- Flag anything fragile or sentimental at the start
- If you've stairs and big furniture, mention it when booking. These lads know what they're doing with awkward stuff

Thanks Dessie and the lads.
